author: Church Machine
source:
; ============================================================
; Abstraction:  ide.Mallory
; Description:  Adversary in the two-enemies containment example
; Language:     Church Machine ISA assembly
; ============================================================
;
; Public method selector:
;   1  Steal() -> faults NO_CAPABILITY
;
; Physical c-list:
;   [0] SELF     E   (minted when the dynamic NS slot is allocated)
;   [1] SCRATCH  RW  (same resident LUMP)
;
; Alice's SECRET_DATA is intentionally absent.  Steal asks CR6 for row 2;
; because Mallory only owns rows 0 and 1, LOAD deterministically faults
; NO_CAPABILITY before any data read can occur.

capabilities {
    __SELF__ E,
    SCRATCH RW
}

BRANCH steal

steal:
LOAD  CR1, CR6, 2
DREAD DR1, CR1, #0
RETURN

WORD 0
description: Deterministically faults NO_CAPABILITY because Alice has no row in Mallory’s c-list.

provenance.disposition: reissued from behavioral specification; supplied token and code were placeholders
